native_independent_review.author: Specialist A
verified_contracts: Every moving target is validated against current owner, body generation, installed geometry, pose serial, material revision, exact payload and incarnation before selection or debit.
Duplicate target cells debit once; shape-cover capacity and cell-write counters preflight before debit; one coherent geometry rebuild follows a changed owner batch.
Highest visible owner wins; every occupied role occludes lower material, while only Structural payload is eligible for structural erasure.
Terrain facade authenticates visible World revision and native instance; coordinator checks all coordinates, exact witnesses and transient/visible owned occupancy before writes.
Complete removal and sleeping-body edits retain established geometry acknowledgement and retirement contracts; removal preserves surviving point velocity, not closed-system momentum.
World and moving ignition skip nonzero combustion countdowns; no-op changes perform zero geometry rebuilds.
Unexpected changed-prefix failures become uncertain held results; pending receipt identity and prefix evidence remain available.

findings_addressed_by_author.finding: Direct native batch parser permitted mismatched outer position and unused nested terrain target; worker and port already rejected these.
findings_addressed_by_author.resolution: Author added empty terrain-target and first-position equality plus bounded nested target checks; implemented and present in frozen v5 native used by the final local integration reruns.

findings_addressed_by_author.finding: Terrain batch lacked preflight of theoretical UINT64 World mutation-journal revision/topology exhaustion.
findings_addressed_by_author.resolution: Author accepted narrow conservative journal headroom/exhausted guard before any selected terrain debit; implemented and present in frozen v5 native used by the final local integration reruns.

native_specialist_findings_closed: Worker rejects unused terrain arrays in moving domain and nonempty/nested target in terrain domain.
Worker repeats first-target/first-position and same-owner revision consistency before native queue copying.
Port authenticates resulting owner/cell/body/pose against first witness and exact erase/ignite/no-op debit/rebuild semantics.
creative_specialist_findings_closed: Cargo and Product foreground occlude ordinary terrain and lower owners.
Structural radius zero remains usable while authored-start brush schema remains valid at its prior minimum of two.
World replacement and explicit seed changes reset the visible weathering pass; effective admitted seed is recorded.
principal_findings_closed: Slice release commits one bounded intent that resolves fresh witnesses at a safe opportunity, expires visibly after two seconds and remains cancellable before admission.
Freehand release, camera changes, tool/material changes, Escape, scene replacement and canvas exit retire future pointer admission.
Monotonic owner IDs map to bounded sorted sprite ranks instead of unbounded z_index values.
Terrain authored-history capacity is reserved before native removal and exact changed coordinates are recorded only after an authenticated receipt.
Capture timestamps originate at actual input-handler arrival; transport clocks distinguish admission, worker queue, native owner service and Main delivery.
All current-generation terminal results are observed in order; all authenticated applied pending diagnostics retire only behind real physics/publication fence.

Refused native actions retain bounded specific outcome/detail and admitted footprint/domain/operation/selection fields without retaining nested target payload or falsely granting application authority.
Current-generation terminal processing has an O(1) newest-result fastpath while publication delivery remains independently polled.
Material-filter control changes cancel gestures; actual published completion replaces the corresponding pending UI message.
Full owner/transport/session identity resets editing diagnostics; malformed optional timing fields cannot crash valid receipt processing.

documented_limits.atomicity: One owner per native transaction; cross-owner freehand gestures are ordered fresh transactions, not atomic.
documented_limits.placements: Slice and Drill choose one owner per placement. Other intersecting domains remain unchanged and are explicitly reported as remaining.
documented_limits.weathering: Effective seed advances once per admitted owner transaction, including admitted no-ops; reset by scene replacement or seed edit.
documented_limits.authored_saves: Save start remains an authored recipe, not a detached live-state checkpoint. Structural terrain erase records require authenticated native changed coordinates.
documented_limits.hardware_scope: Local Linux development host. No physical TITAN RTX, Windows extraction or owner-evaluation claim.

retained_development_failures: The first value-only transport fixture inserted new keys via GDScript dot syntax, yielding StringName keys rejected by strict String-key transport. Fixture corrected to bracket insertion; production request builder already used bracket/literal keys.
The first retained fragment run omitted CYBERSAND_SOURCE_REVISION and failed only source metadata equality; explicit local-delta rerun passed 134 checks.

The first retained lifecycle run loaded the prior premise that ignition radius is disabled. The expanded mandatory area-ignition tool requires editable radius. Test now covers all structural tools and retains pointer cancellation and inventory assertions; rerun passed 1007 checks.
